q: Do I need to watch everything before Doomsday?
a: No. You don't need all 40 films. Disney+'s official list is 15 titles, and our Weekend Sprint covers the essentials in 5. If you only have a weekend, watch Endgame, X2, Deadpool & Wolverine, Thunderbolts* and The Fantastic Four: First Steps.

q: Does it end on a cliffhanger like Infinity War?
a: Expect it to lead straight into the next film. The Russos say Doomsday and Secret Wars were designed to speak to each other as one complete story, but not in exactly the same way Infinity War and Endgame did.

q: Is Doctor Doom just Tony Stark from another universe?
a: Marvel says no. Kevin Feige told Empire: “He's Victor Von Doom.” He also joked, “Is Steve Rogers a Johnny Storm variant?” Joe Russo has said the fact that Doom looks like Tony will all make sense when you see the film.

q: Why isn't Kang the villain anymore?
a: Kang was set up as the big bad in Loki and Quantumania. After Jonathan Majors was convicted at the end of 2023, Marvel let him go. Feige has said they had already started to feel Kang wasn't as big a threat as Thanos. In 2024 The Kang Dynasty was retitled Avengers: Doomsday, with Doom as the villain of both films.

q: Why does Doom want Franklin Richards?
a: Nobody knows yet. In First Steps, Galactus said Franklin has immeasurable power and wanted him for it. Doom shows up next to Franklin in the mid-credits scene, so expect that power to matter.

q: Is Wanda (the Scarlet Witch) in Doomsday?
a: Very likely, though Elizabeth Olsen isn't on the official cast list. VisionQuest's finale (Nov 10, 2026) ends with a post-credits scene in which Doctor Doom brings Wanda back in the ruins of Mount Wundagore.
It's when two universes collide and destroy each other. Multiverse of Madness introduced the idea, and Clea told Strange he'd caused one. In the comics, incursions lead directly to Secret Wars.

q: Are the old Fox X-Men part of the MCU now?
a: Yes, as their own universe. Deadpool & Wolverine confirmed the Fox films take place on Earth-10005, a real reality the TVA watches over. The original cast (Stewart, McKellen, Marsden, Romijn, Cumming, Grammer) is confirmed for Doomsday.

q: Do I need to watch the old X-Men movies?
a: X-Men and X2 are on Disney+'s official list, and X2 is the one most guides say to pick if you only watch one. Days of Future Past is useful too, because it rewrote how the original trilogy ends.
It's the only series on the official list, and season 2's ending is about holding the multiverse together, so it's very useful. If you're short on time, at least watch the season 2 finale.

q: Was that Fantastic Four ship in Thunderbolts* their ship?
a: Probably, but not for sure. The ship has the Fantastic Four logo and enters Earth's orbit from another dimension. Feige teased that he's “not sure they're the same ship” as the one they fly in First Steps.
